summary_1line: Rama and Lakshmana visit King Pramati, then reach Gautama’s deserted hermitage where Vishwamitra begins recounting the story of Ahalya and Indra.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Pramati greets Vishwamitra with folded hands while Rama and Lakshmana stand beside the sage, radiant and armed, in the royal court.
Rama and Lakshmana stand before a beautiful but eerily deserted forest hermitage as Vishwamitra prepares to reveal its tragic history.
Indra, disguised as the sage Gautama, approaches Ahalya alone in the quiet hermitage while the real sage is away.
